items.title: Superhuman’s AI advantage: measuring the business value of AI adoption
items.summary: This post shares quantified results of the company Superhuman, which made AI to be the default way of work for their platform team. As a result, developer output rose 60%, 1,300 autonomous pull requests shipped in a single half, and experimentation rates tripled. This post looks at how the Superhuman’s platform team did it, what […]
